craft_claim: Unearned emotion (melodrama/sentimentality) occurs when dramatic catastrophism or weeping exceeds the established psychological and causal stakes.

supporting_evidence.note: Gardner defines sentimentality as demanding an emotional response greater than the situation justifies.
Prose demonstrates how understated physical gesture conveys genuine grief far more powerfully than histrionic crying.
Premchand avoids florid theatrical laments, rendering Hori's death with austere factual quietude.

exceptions: Camp, opera, or deliberate Victorian melodrama where exaggerated performance is the recognized aesthetic code.
